commitMessage: Link to the Jolli Memory guide from the main README

topics.title: Add link from main README to Jolli Memory viewing guide
topics.trigger: The user wanted the main project README to reference the Jolli Memory guide that had just been added, so visitors to the repo would know the guide exists and how to find it.
topics.response: Added a new "Project memory" section at the bottom of `README.md` with a brief description of Jolli Memory and a relative link to `docs/jolli-memory/README-JOLLI-MEMORY.md`.
topics.decisions: The link was added to the same branch as the guide itself so that both the guide and its entry point would ship together in a single pull request, keeping the repository in a consistent state at every commit.

plans.title: Viewing Jolli Memory for the Snake Game repo
